title: End Recipes
description: Datapack to add custom recipes replacing cobblestone with end stone for stone things, and adding ways to get things like wood, blaze rods and saplings without going to other dimensions.
body:
This datapack adds balanced custom recipes for End-only survival, allowing players to obtain normally inaccessible resources without leaving the End.
  Stone recipes now use End Stone instead of Cobblestone, while new recipes provide access to essentials like wood, saplings, blaze rods, and end crystals.  Goes well with "Skniro's Nether and End Ores" mod.
